en.title: Choosing a Truck with Strictly Larger Capacity for Each Package
en.description:
Each package independently chooses a truck whose capacity is strictly greater than its weight: first minimize the capacity, then choose the smallest original index among trucks with that capacity. Indices start at 0; output −1 if no truck is available. Loading does not consume truck capacity.

This site independently prepared the standard I/O and the solution; bounds supplemented where the source lacks them and corrections to examples are stated explicitly in the specification.
en.input: The first line contains n m, the second line contains n capacities, and the third line contains m weights. Original bounds: 1≤n,m≤100000; capacities and weights are all 1..10^9.
en.output: Output m truck indices or −1, in package order.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 0 3 -1; 1 0 -1; 0 2. Verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Sort by capacity, keeping the smallest index for each capacity, then binary search for the first capacity strictly greater than the weight.
